say:3:1220360001:1.text: Tucker isn't here, and he's no longer in charge of guarding the warehouse.
say:3:1220360001:1.source_cn: 塔克没在这，现在不负责看守仓库了。
say:3:1220360001:1.male: Tucker isn't here, and he's no longer in charge of guarding the warehouse.
say:3:1220360001:1.female: Tucker isn't here, and he's no longer in charge of guarding the warehouse.

say:4:1220360002:1.text: Are you his friends? I didn't know he had friends. That guy never talks to people. I always thought he was mute.
say:4:1220360002:1.source_cn: 你们是塔克的朋友？我不知道他还有朋友哎，那个人很少和别...
say:4:1220360002:1.male: Are you his friends? I didn't know he had friends. That guy never talks to people. I always thought he was mute.
say:4:1220360002:1.female: Are you his friends? I didn't know he had friends. That guy never talks to people. I always thought he was mute.

say:5:1220360003:1.text: He's not mute! He just doesn't like to talk!
say:5:1220360003:1.source_cn: 人家可不是哑巴！只是不喜欢说话！

say:6:1220360004:1.source_cn: 对、对不起！我只是打个比方……

say:7:1220360005:1.text: We want to see Tucker. Where is he?
say:7:1220360005:1.source_cn: 我们想见塔克，他在哪里？

say:8:1220360006:1.text: The boss recently give him an important job. He seems to be very busy. I'm not sure what he's doing though.
say:8:1220360006:1.source_cn: 大当家最近委派了很重要的工作给他，他好像很忙，具体是什...

say:9:1220360007:0.text: If you take the lift up and walk around, you might run into him.
say:9:1220360007:0.source_cn: 你们坐电梯去上层的广场转转，有可能会碰到他。
say:9:1220360007:0.male: If you take the lift up and walk around, you might run into him.
say:9:1220360007:0.female: If you take the lift up and walk around, you might run into him.
